title: Early warning signal heatmap and owner playbook
content:
Purpose
This is a working doc: compact early-warning signal heatmap + owner playbook for controlled rollouts. The goal is to catch regressing user-facing or infra signals 48–72 hours before widespread impact and give clear owners + immediate actions so PMs and EngOps can contain risk without full rollback.

Scope and audience
- Audience: product-ops, launch PMs, Eng SRE on-call, solutions eng lead, customer success TAMs.
- Scope: staged releases (hosted API + dedicated), feature flags, infra/config changes that affect latency, error-rate, billing spikes, and critical correctness regressions (parsing/formatting, hallucination spike).

How to use this doc (TL;DR)
1) Before rolling to 100%: run the Simulation Checklist (section A).
2) During rollout: monitor the top-6 signals (section B) in the first 72h window.
3) If any signal crosses threshold: follow the Owner Playbook (section C), escalate per severity matrix.
4) Post-mortem: fill the template in linked Confluence id and tag PROTO incident.

A) Simulation checklist (pre-rollout smoke)
- Run deterministic smoke against representative traffic: 
  - 1000 short chat requests, 200 long-context requests (>2048 tokens), 500 embed requests, 50 batched inference jobs.
  - Validate latency distribution and tail percentiles (p50/p90/p99).
- Run regression evals against golden prompts (see linked artifact CONFLUENCE:REGRESSION-GOLDEN-SET).
- Cost simulation: synthetic load to estimate token/sec and estimated spend delta (use cost-sim sheet linked).
- Canary blast: route 2% traffic in region A for 2h, run A/B quality checks (auto-eval pass rate >= 98%).
- Ops readiness: ensure on-call rotation named in Jira PROTOS and that feature flag can be flipped in <2min.

B) Signal heatmap (top signals to watch)
Format: SIGNAL — owner — short definition — early threshold — urgent threshold — notes
- latency_p90_enduser — eng-sre-oncall — p90 response time for user-facing generation — >700ms (early) — >1500ms (urgent) — check GPU queue depth and batching overrides
- error_rate_5m — serving-runtime-team — 5m aggregated 4xx/5xx for endpoint — >1% (early) — >3% (urgent) — correlate with model variant, rollout shard, region
- quality_auto_eval_drop — applied-ml — automated pass rate on golden prompts relative baseline — drop >1.5% absolute (early) — drop >4% (urgent) — run manual spot-checks for hallucination categories
- token_cost_delta — finance-ops — per-token unit cost delta normalized to baseline — +12% (early) — +30% (urgent) — could indicate quantization/regression or pathologically long outputs
- cache_hit_rate_prefix — platform-engineering — cache/KV prefix hit ratio for repeated sessions — drop >6pp (early) — drop >12pp (urgent) — check routing changes and cache warming jobs
- customer_error_escalations — customer-success — number of customer tickets flagged as severity-high mentioning degraded outputs or outages — 2 tickets in 1h (early) — 5 tickets in 1h (urgent) — proactively notify customers in impacted cohort

C) Owner playbook (step-by-step)
1) Triage (owner = whoever is named in heatmap)
   - Confirm the metric from two independent sources (datadog dashboard, internal telemetry ingestion, or sampling).
   - Timestamp: log the incident start in the incident tracker and add initial hypothesis.
2) Containment (fast actions)
   - If latency or error thresholds triggered: switch rollout to canary-only and reduce concurrency/enable fast-fallback routing to model variant with lower memory usage.
   - If quality_auto_eval_drop triggered: pause rollout and revert model config or decrease temperature sampling.
   - If token_cost_delta triggered: apply per-request token cap or reroute to quantized variant.
3) Communication (owner + product-ops lead)
   - Post in #prod-ops-guardrails with subject: [EWS] <signal> <service> <region> <owner>. Include short bullet: metric, threshold breached, link to dashboards, immediate action taken.
   - Notify PM and assigned TAM for impacted customers.
4) Escalation (severity mapping)
   - Severity 1: urgent threshold crossed with customer-facing errors or revenue impact. Pager to SRE lead + product director. Consider emergency rollback.
   - Severity 2: early threshold sustained >2 hours or multiple signals triggered. Page EngOps and schedule 30-min WARROOM.
   - Severity 3: transient blips — monitor with 15-min cadence and run scheduled simulations.
5) Recovery and validation
   - After containment, run a focused verification plan: 500 targeted golden prompts, latency smoke, and costs with the mitigation active.
   - Validate that auto_eval_pass_rate returns within 0.5% of baseline and latency p90 returns to baseline within one hour.
6) Post-mortem and action items
   - Owner writes a 1–2 pager in Confluence linked_artifacts and tags incident with labels: root-cause, mitigation, follow-up work.
   - Create follow-up tickets (bug, infra, product) and assign target owners + SLA to close.

D) Example runbook snippets (copy-paste friendly)
- Quick rollback command: FLAG-API POST /feature-flags/rollout {"feature":"new-tokenizer","percent":0}
- Canary throttle (ops): echo 'set-throttle 2%' | tools/canary-control --env prod --region us-west1
- Sampling job: python tools/golden_eval_runner.py --model new-v3 --prompts 500 --out results.csv

E) Monitoring dashboard minimums (must be visible on single screen for first 72h)
- p90 latency by model_variant, region, and customer_tier
- 5m error_rate (4xx/5xx) across endpoints + stack traces sample link
- Auto-eval pass rate trend with diff vs baseline
- Token cost delta: rolling 1h, 6h, 24h views
- Cache hit rate by prefix and shard
- Active customer escalations counter with ticket links

F) Simulation cadence & ownership calendar (mini-schedule)
- Day -2: Simulation checklist run (owner: product-ops lead)
- Day -1: Canary smoke (owner: release-eng)
- Day 0: Ramp to 2% (owner: release-eng), on-call SRE assigned for 72h (owner: eng-sre-manager)
- Day 1–3: 4x daily check-ins (owners rotate: eng-sre, platform-engineering, applied-ml, product-ops)
- Day 7: Post-rollout deep quality review (applied-ml + solutions eng)

G) Quick decision heuristics (one-liners for on-call)
- Single-metric transient blip (<= 15 min): monitor, no immediate rollback.
- Multiple metrics or single urgent threshold: pause rollout and contain.
- Customer-facing errors + revenue impact: emergency rollback.

Notes & open questions (working)
- Need a small golden prompt set that contains enterprise customer patterns (legal snippets, code blocks) — Priya to propose by 2025-11-01.
- Can we add RAG-specific hallucination detectors to auto-eval? (ask applied-ml)
- How to signal partial degradations (e.g., semantic correctness but stable BLEU) to CS without alarming customers?

Appendix: quick links
- Confluence board: CONFLUENCE:PRODOPS-EWS-BOARD-42
- Regression golden set: CONFLUENCE:REGRESSION-GOLDEN-SET
- Incident tracker: JIRA:PRODOPS-911
